summary: react-tabulix-core preinstall hook fetches and eval()s remote code
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs dist/index.d.js. That script contains a base64-encoded payload decoded via Buffer.from(...,'base64').toString('utf-8') and executed through an `eval` reference constructed at runtime from String.fromCharCode char codes ([101,118,97,108]). The decoded payload fetches https://everydaynodechecker-39145n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root3 and passes the response body to eval at install time, yielding arbitrary remote code execution on any machine running `npm install react-tabulix-core`. The destination is an anonymous vercel.app subdomain unrelated to the advertised React table library, and the eval-name obfuscation is a deliberate evasion of static scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
